label: Attribute Picker
description: Nested attribute picker that drills down level by level. Best for person, company and workspace fields with a type glyph per row, counts on branches and a field path capped at 3 parts.

label: Multi-Select Cap
description: Multi-select permissions with a cap. Best for product area permissions like billing and deployments, capped at 5, with one disabled row and a clear X in the field and in the sheet's footer.

label: Deep Search
description: Deep search across every level, each result with its path. Best for a source file tree whose search reaches files below the open folder, with folder paths telling repeated names like page.tsx apart.

label: Avatar Rows
description: Rows with avatars and role badges. Best for an assignee picker by team, each member row with an avatar, an online or away dot and a seniority chip, the face repeated in the field.

label: Embedded Panel
description: Embedded panel with no sheet. Best for a docs table of contents searched and drilled right on the screen inside a card, with the list height capped at 240 pt.

label: Flat Data
description: Flat rows with a parent pointer. Best for region and department rows as a database returns them, unsorted with a parent id each, plus a footer button that resets the pick.

label: Controlled State
description: Controlled path, value and search. Best for a restaurant menu where outside buttons drive the open level and the search text, and each pick reports its reason and full path.

label: Translated Labels
description: Translated labels. Best for data and words both in German, down to plural forms like 1 Land and 2 Länder read to screen readers.

label: Two-Line Rows
description: Two-line rows with descriptions and a disabled option. Best for data center locations from country to city, each row a tile plus a second line of counts or region codes, with China locked.

label: Native Form Field
description: A field in a form. Best for a support topic field in a labelled form, required on submit and read back with the message.

label: Columns Mode
description: Columns mode with columns that scroll on their own. Best for video, audio and article items grouped by library and collection, with a hued tile per library and a runtime chip on items.

label: Tree Mode
description: Tree mode with branches that open in place. Best for a move to destination picker whose top level splits into Recently used and All spaces, reordering each time a folder is picked.

label: Async Loading
description: Levels that load on demand. Best for repositories, releases and release assets fetched when opened, with a toned badge per row and a button that fails the next request to show Retry.

label: Virtualized List
description: A virtualized level with thousands of rows. Best for nearly 3,000 generated sales markets with flags, a territory name and a reach badge toned by tier.

label: Removable Chips
description: Removable chips drawn by the caller, named with their path. Best for a report builder that adds table columns several at a time, counting them in the field and listing each as a removable chip below.

label: Tree Multi-Select
description: Cascading tree multi-select. Best for shipping zones by continent, region and country, where 1 tap takes a whole region and the field names the regions plus a country total.

label: Color Dots
description: Colour dots through renderLabel. Best for workflow fields such as status, priority, severity and effort, each value marked by a coloured dot that the field repeats beside its group.

label: Inherited Colors
description: Accounts with a colour inherited down each branch. Best for a chart of accounts where any level can be booked, each row with its ledger code and spend.

label: Global Search
description: Global search from inside a level. Best for a store taxonomy preset to Headphones, with 2 Chargers rows under different branches told apart by their trail.

label: Footer Flyout
description: A footer action that opens a second menu. Best for a property picker whose footer opens a menu of 7 app and data source logos in 2 named groups.

label: Path Formatting
description: Path formatting and shortening. Best for a connected app tree with a switch between collapsed, full, tail, leaf and a custom two line field.
